lines.say: In World War Two, they studied bullet holes in returning bombers.
The holes were on the wings and the body. Almost none on the engines.
So the generals said, add armor where the holes are.
But a mathematician named Abraham Wald said, no.
Armor the engines. Those planes never came back.
The damage you can see isn't the real problem.
Customers who quietly leave never say a word.
Message Health shows who's going quiet, before they leave.
Every client gets a health score. Slipping ones get flagged.
Then a text or email goes out to win them back.
Want to see who's slipping away?
Comment keep, for a free retention audit.
